Design review found that the pixel list returns event data TikTok refreshes every 2-4 hours and the conversion list returns activity counts, so the review state keeps only pixel identity and ownership and each conversion definition; otherwise a review would be invalidated by routine activity.

limitations: Synthetic validation only; no live provider credentials, reads or account mutations in this batch.
TikTok types rule values as string[] and describes numeric parameters as integers or two-decimal floats; values are accepted as strings and compared numerically on read-back.
Standard event names are refused by comparison with the documented pixel event display names and values; TikTok may reject other names it treats as standard.
Account-wide name uniqueness and the 1,000-per-account limit are enforced by TikTok; the review checks the selected pixel only.
